exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) using the GELFOAM technique
cohort: The study included 41 patients with cervical and cesarean scar ectopic pregnancies treated at a single tertiary center.
finding: Uterine artery embolization with GELFOAM appears to be an effective, fertility-preserving option for cervical and cesarean-scar ectopic pregnancy in selected patients, with a high rate of uterine preservation and low complications.
